limitations: All scores are provisional browser judgments from the supplied screenshots, chronological still filmstrips and runtime report; I did not run the app or independently reproduce the reported tests.
The schema provides no aggregate fields; calculate each A and F from its applicable dimensions, then overall = round(0.4A + 0.6F, 1). Null is used only where a dimension is genuinely inapplicable.
The authorized threshold is not met: multiple screen and component aesthetic means remain below 9, especially dense reading typography, large-text task hierarchy and room-transition coherence.

No hard-gate failure is established by this evidence: partially visible content in scroll-position captures does not prove unreachable content, and the supplied browser tests report traversal and action reachability.
Reported contrast, axe, keyboard, persistence, reduced-motion and constrained-viewport checks support browser accessibility scores but do not establish universal accessibility.

Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native keyboard, haptics, tilt, OS sharing, notification delivery and native performance remain deferred; no deduction was applied solely for those boundaries and no full/native 9–10 certification is given.
Filmstrips establish sampled visual changes, not continuous video smoothness or frame rate; performance claims rely on the separately supplied isolated timing report.
Stationary foreground bounds support geometric stability but do not prove camera continuity, independent painted-layer depth or parallax.
Connected Circles behavior and successful native voice are not demonstrated; the represented offline and unavailable states were evaluated on their own merits.
Billing and navigator.share are simulated, and synthetic reading content demonstrates layout only, not model quality, factual grounding or predictive accuracy.
Dedicated focus/pressed and target evidence for the miniature room destination controls is missing, and the supplied Sky evidence is less specific than that for shared forms and buttons.
No repeated novice-use evidence is supplied, so exemplary outcome-based scores are not established.
topFixes: Coordinate room paintings and destination content during navigation; the filmstrips show content arriving before the background resolves and settles.
Keep the enlarged Approach title physically associated with the table instead of letting its second line fall below it.
Improve dense centered reading typography with clearer internal headings, tighter within-group spacing and stronger separation between groups.
Reduce enlarged check-in card height around the forecast so outcome selection, unsaved status and Save are encountered sooner.
Differentiate secondary navigation, disclosures and destructive actions instead of using long stacks of equally emphasized text links.
Strengthen parchment focus/pressed visibility and supply dedicated interaction evidence for room destination and Sky theme controls.
Condense enlarged privacy, optional-form and invitation helper copy while preserving complete explanations through clearly grouped disclosures.
